urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Pages to audit, one per line. Domains without https:// work too.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Mobile uses Lighthouse's phone profile with simulated slow 4G, desktop its desktop profile: the same lab settings as PageSpeed Insights. Each URL is audited once per device.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Fewer categories run a little faster.

saveHtmlReport.title: Save the full HTML report
saveHtmlReport.description: Stores the standard Lighthouse HTML report for each audit and adds its link as reportUrl.

maxConcurrency.title: Audits at a time
maxConcurrency.description: 1 gives the most stable timings. 2-3 finish big lists faster; give the run 4 GB+ of memory.

maxResults.title: Maximum audits
maxResults.description: Stop after this many audits (URLs x devices).
